response.overview: # Translation  The story revolves around two groups of pontianak (vampires) who are descendants of Raja Bersiong. They no longer feed on human blood; instead, they use synthetic blood as a replacement. The most powerful pontianak kingdom at that time was led by a Vampire Queen named Queen Citra Sari and assisted by a commander-in-chief named Shah. Meanwhile, another group is led by Argus, who is the son of Panglima Adi Wijaya, who had betrayed Raja Bersiong, the father of Queen Citra Sari. Approximately 200 years ago, Raja Bersiong killed Adi Wijaya and his army by burying them in the ground through his incantation. Argus attempts to resurrect these soldiers, and this can only be done with a "Bersiong knife" along with a special incantation.
response.title: Sinopsis KL Vampires
